SELECT settlement_order_id AS settlementOrderId, worker_name AS workerName, CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(period_start, '%Y-%m-%d'), ' ~ ', DATE_FORMAT(period_end, '%Y-%m-%d')) AS period, CONCAT('¥', FORMAT(amount_should_settle, 2)) AS amountShouldSettle, CONCAT('¥', FORMAT(deduct_amount, 2)) AS deductAmount, CONCAT('¥', FORMAT(amount_net_settle, 2)) AS amountNetSettle, CONCAT('¥', FORMAT(deposit_impact_amount, 2)) AS depositImpactAmount, status, status_type AS statusType, payout_status AS payoutStatus, payout_status_type AS payoutStatusType FROM t_worker_settlement_order
ORDER BY period_end DESC, created_at DESC LIMIT #{query.limit} OFFSET #{query.offset}

SELECT COUNT(1) AS totalSettlementCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status = '待审核' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pendingAuditCount, SUM(CASE WHEN payout_status = '待出款' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS payoutPendingCount, SUM(CASE WHEN payout_status = '出款中' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS payingCount, SUM(CASE WHEN payout_status = '出款成功' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS payoutSuccessCount, CONCAT('¥', FORMAT(COALESCE(SUM(amount_net_settle), 0), 2)) AS totalNetSettleAmount, CONCAT('¥', FORMAT(COALESCE(SUM(deduct_amount), 0), 2)) AS totalDeductAmount, CONCAT('¥', FORMAT(COALESCE(SUM(deposit_impact_amount), 0), 2)) AS totalDepositImpactAmount, SUM(CASE WHEN amount_net_settle < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS negativeNetSettleCount FROM t_worker_settlement_order
